name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – After § 22 – Am 10
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: 22a. Insists that the only lasting solution to the threats to human life, regional stability and food security in the Black Sea is to end Russia’s aggression, through an immediate ceasefire and a just and lasting peace, negotiated in accordance with the UN Charter and international law; calls on the EU to finally assume an active role as a mediator and to support all diplomatic efforts in this direction;
